title: Krull dimension of a finite-variable polynomial ring over a Noetherian ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $I$ be a finite set of cardinality $n\in\mathbf N$. For the polynomial ring $R[x_i:i\in I]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], one has $\dim R[x_i:i\in I]=\dim R+n$, where $\dim$ is the ring Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], valued in $\{-\infty,0,1,\ldots,\infty\}$ with $-\infty+n=-\infty$. The zero ring and $n=0$ are included.
